# Thunder stone

Type: Material | Internal ID: Thunderstone | Source: Haldor | Usage: Building | Buy: 50, Coins | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Thunder stone is an item which got introduced in the Hearth & Home update and is used to construct the Obliterator.

## Availability

• Purchased from the trader Haldor for 50 Coins a piece, after defeating The Elder.

### Building

• Obliterator

Categorias: Materials
